role.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-10-11: the deliberation reviewer must be a reasoning model, not the writer-role model, which is tuned for vault and graph memory work. The resolver's manually declared 'session' role (adopted 2026-10-09 for /auditthesis-sized local sessions) names it. The tag itself is never written here: model_resolver.py names it at run time (R2)

num_ctx.provenance: chosen 2026-10-11, PROVISIONAL: the session-role tag has no entry in local-model-config.json (the sweep only measures writer and coder candidates), so the window cannot be read from a measurement. 16384 is the window the pdf2md vision checks already ran this tag at on this card; a deliberation question and its reply fit it, and a larger window only adds CPU latency (the operator's own sweep of 2026-10-09 measured 2.40 tok/s decode at 262144). Prompt plus reply over this window is refused, never truncated

request_timeout_s.provenance: chosen by the operator 2026-10-11 ("Qwen est lent, c'est pas grave, c'est fait la nuit"). The same tag was measured at 2.40 tok/s decode on 2026-10-09, so a full reply budget takes about fifteen minutes

reply_tokens.provenance: chosen 2026-10-11, PROVISIONAL: twice the bridge's own 1024-token reply reserve, so a review of max_suggestions terse suggestions is not cut off. To be revised after the first measured run on the real model

seed.provenance: chosen 2026-10-11 (R19): a fixed sampling seed so the same prompt gives the same request
